items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: He was raised with Lloyd Primm and all of us.

ctx.x: Yeah, names I just never heard of. I never heard of Speck Reagan that I know of. He's from New Orleans.

I don't think he was, but he used to sit in the arrogant and all. When you talk about piano players, there's a piano player that I'd like you to hear sometimes. He's a colored fellow. His name is Noel Fusher. He was raised with Lloyd Primm and all of us. Yeah, I don't know him. No, I don't think he did. He had a civil service job. He used to work under me over the port. His uncle played up and he used to call him all this. He used to call Bill Willie. He'd talk about fine kind of thing. It was Bornell Santiago,…
I knew his brother, but I never met him in time. Blackie, I knew him.
